statement: ∀ (X : Type) (x y : X), x ≠ y → T2Space X ∧ ¬T2Space X
script:
# name: set-discrete-hausdorff-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Hausdorff.discrete_indiscrete_hausdorff
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['Fin 2', '0', '1', '(by decide)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (X : Type) (x y : X) (hxy : x ≠ y), @T2Space X ⊥ ∧ ¬ @T2Space X ⊤ := by
  intro X x y hxy
  refine ⟨by letI : TopologicalSpace X := ⊥; haveI : DiscreteTopology X := ⟨rfl⟩; infer_instance, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hxU, hyV, hUV⟩ := @t2_separation X ⊤ h x y hxy
  rw [@TopologicalSpace.isOpen_top_iff] at hU hV
  rcases hU with rfl | rfl
  · exact hxU
  · rcases hV with rfl | rfl
    · exact hyV
    · exact (Set.nonempty_of_mem hxU).ne_empty (Set.disjoint_univ.1 hUV)
exact @key (Fin 2) (0) (1) ((by decide))'),
    (['Fin 3', '0', '2', '(by decide)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (X : Type) (x y : X) (hxy : x ≠ y), @T2Space X ⊥ ∧ ¬ @T2Space X ⊤ := by
  intro X x y hxy
  refine ⟨by letI : TopologicalSpace X := ⊥; haveI : DiscreteTopology X := ⟨rfl⟩; infer_instance, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hxU, hyV, hUV⟩ := @t2_separation X ⊤ h x y hxy
  rw [@TopologicalSpace.isOpen_top_iff] at hU hV
  rcases hU with rfl | rfl
  · exact hxU
  · rcases hV with rfl | rfl
    · exact hyV
    · exact (Set.nonempty_of_mem hxU).ne_empty (Set.disjoint_univ.1 hUV)
exact @key (Fin 3) (0) (2) ((by decide))'),
    (['ℕ', '0', '1', '(by decide)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (X : Type) (x y : X) (hxy : x ≠ y), @T2Space X ⊥ ∧ ¬ @T2Space X ⊤ := by
  intro X x y hxy
  refine ⟨by letI : TopologicalSpace X := ⊥; haveI : DiscreteTopology X := ⟨rfl⟩; infer_instance, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hxU, hyV, hUV⟩ := @t2_separation X ⊤ h x y hxy
  rw [@TopologicalSpace.isOpen_top_iff] at hU hV
  rcases hU with rfl | rfl
  · exact hxU
  · rcases hV with rfl | rfl
    · exact hyV
    · exact (Set.nonempty_of_mem hxU).ne_empty (Set.disjoint_univ.1 hUV)
exact @key (ℕ) (0) (1) ((by decide))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
